metrics.tracking_rate: share of pieces followed to the end within tolerance
metrics.beat_median: median |beat error| (perf->score), pooled over tracked pieces
metrics.ms_median: median |ms error| (score->perf), pooled over tracked pieces
metrics.beat_median_all: median |beat error| over every piece, lost ones included
metrics.rtf: real-time factor: processing time / performance duration
metrics.estimated_bpm: the follower was given the performance's tempo instead of the score's notated one — marked * in the table
